selected_script.angle: Replacing messy wet towels with a dry, passive pet cooling mat
selected_script.hook: I used to soak towels in cold water to keep my dog cool, but it just made a huge wet mess everywhere.

video_001.visual: 0-3s: Handheld shot of a person laying a damp, dripping gray bath towel onto a hardwood floor for a panting dog. 3-5s: Close-up showing water pooling on the floorboards as the dog sniffs the soggy towel and backs away, refusing to lie on the wet mess. 5-8.5s: The person tosses the wet towel aside and unfolds a pale ice-blue Bedsure rectangular pet cooling mat with white edge piping and soft wave quilting. A dog immediately steps onto the thin, padded mat and lies down. 8.5-10s: Stable close-up of the dog resting comfortably on the cool-touch pale blue fabric, showing a dry, mess-free floor.
video_001.audio: I used to soak towels in cold water to keep my dog cool, but it just made a huge wet mess everywhere. Then I switched to this Bedsure cooling mat. No gel, no water, just instant comfort. Way easier than I expected.
